d.seg: ಮದುವೆ ಆಗೋ ತನಕ ನಾನೇ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಾಯ್ ಫ್ರೆಣ್ಡು
d.tr: Until you get married, I am your boyfriend
d.ctx: The speaker talks about marriage and then claims to be the user's boyfriend, to which the other person replies casually.
d.j: It falls under allowed relationship talk (boyfriend/girlfriend), so it is not a violation.
